findings.competence: No NeuroPixel realization reaches 0.95 on either population. Transformer seeds 60 and 63 pass both descriptively; neither family has an all-five pass.
findings.conclusion: The report faithfully describes a completed negative NeuroPixel competence/comparison result under a fixed externally authored synthetic-task recipe, without claiming universal incapacity or a mechanism attribution.
